Shaper dispatch: script-to-shaper routing and shared predicates.

Ports the categorize routing from harfrust ot/shaper/mod.rs plus the preferred script-tag resolution (all_tags_from_script): Indic scripts and Myanmar resolve to their current-spec xxx2 tags (with xxx3 tried first, routing Indic xxx3 fonts to USE) before falling back to the old tag and DFLT.

Imports

../direction, ../script, ../tag, map

Types

ShaperKind = enum
  skDefault, skArabic, skHebrew, skHangul, skThai, skIndic, skKhmer, skMyanmar,
  skUse

Procs

proc categorizeShaper(script: Option[Script]; isHorizontal: bool;
                      gsubScript: Option[Tag] = none(Tag)): ShaperKind {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Mirrors harfrust categorize. Indic-family scripts fall back to the default shaper when the font only targets DFLT/latn (or, for Indic, route to USE for xxx3 script tags), matching the "designer designed for DFLT" rule. 
proc chooseGsubScript(gsub: GsubData; script: Option[Script]; oldTag: Tag): Tag {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Resolves the shaping script tag against the font: the first preferred tag present in GSUB, else DFLT when present, else the old tag (preserving the previous no-table behaviour). 
proc gposHasMark(gpos: GposData; scriptTag, langTag: Tag): bool {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Whether the mark feature resolves to lookups for the script. Mirrors harfrust plan.has_gpos_mark (used to gate Hebrew presentation-form composition). 
proc gsubScriptTagFor(gsub: GsubData; scriptTag: Tag): Option[Tag] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
The GSUB script record tag that scriptTag resolves to: the exact script when present, else the DFLT record, else none. 
proc newTagFor(script: Script): Option[Tag] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Current-spec OT script tag (xxx2) for the nine Indic scripts plus Myanmar, mirroring harfrust new_tag_from_script. Others have no new tag. 
proc preferredScriptTags(script: Script; oldTag: Tag): seq[Tag] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
OpenType script tags from most to least preferred, mirroring harfrust all_tags_from_script: the xxx3 variant (except Myanmar, which has no xxx3), then xxx2, then the old tag.
